reason: As written the falsifier does not discriminate. (1) No null/control arm: no random_matched null (ffd_semaev_core.random_matched exists) and no same-ideal-extra-variables control. (2) System (b) is unspecified; worked out, Lambda in L(4O)=<1,x,y,x^2> monic with Lambda(P1..P3)=0 and Lambda(-R)=0 is 4 linear conditions on 3 unknown coefficients, so eliminating Lambda gives det[1,x_i,y_i,x_i^2]=0 over P1,P2,P3,-R, i.e. a y-lifted determinant/group-law presentation. Any d_F drop vs bare S_4 is then explained by added y_i variables (cubic in bits plus Artin-Schreier y^2+xy=..) and cannot be attributed to the coding-theory/key-equation view; the HPST bilinear-Semaev and chain-S_3-with-auxiliary-variable presentations are the proper nulls. (3) Lambda unnormalised gives positive-dimensional ideal (F_{2^n}^* scaling), so msolve degrees are meaningless unless Lambda is made monic. (4) Metric conflation: msolve F4 max degree is a solving degree (grevlex, variable-count dependent), not the last fall degree d_F; degrees across presentations with different variable counts are not same-ideal comparable. Mixed outcomes (lower at some n only) are not covered by the decision rule. (5) Scaling: l=3..6 with n in {13..21} gives l/n from 0.14 to 0.46 and mostly under/over-determined cells; the relevant regime is l~n/m (l=ceil(n/3)); 4 n-values cannot establish 'grows slower'; n=21 is composite (F_8,F_128 subfields). Existing programme fit is D vs l at fixed n (m=3: ceil(l/2)+4), so slope in l is the quantity to compare. (6) Runtime: arm (a) trivially cheap (ic corpus + anf->msolve, 24 Boolean vars 0.2 s) but arm (b) as stated adds ~3n+3l variables (60-90 Boolean) in grevlex F4 and 640 runs (4n x 4l x 20 x 2 arms) will not fit 18 CPU-min unless capped. Toy result says nothing about n=131 beyond slope-in-l trend; B*D^2<N is untestable at toy, so verdict can only be classification (relabelling vs presentation with lower slope).
fix: Redesign. ARMS on identical targets (same E, same random F_2-subspace V of dim l, same R, same seed): (A) descended S_4 + field eqs (ic corpus --degree n --dimension l, anf->msolve with v^2+v appended). (B1) y-lifted determinant presentation: unknowns bits b_i (l each, i=1..3) and y_i as n-bit vectors with y_i^2+x_i y_i+x_i^3+a2 x_i^2+a6=0 descended, plus det[1,x,y,x^2] over (P1,P2,P3,-R)=0 descended; no Lambda. (B2) the proposed key-equation presentation: Lambda=x^2+a2' y+a1' x+a0' monic (fixes scaling), a-coefficients as n-bit unknowns, equations Lambda(P_i)=0 (i=1..3), Lambda(-R)=0, y_i as in B1. (C) HPST/chain control: S_3(x1,x2,t)=S_3(x3,xR,t)=0 with t an n-bit unknown in no subspace. (N) null: ffd_semaev_core.random_matched system with same monomial/shape and variable counts as A and as B2. DECISION RULE: relabelling iff B2 solving degree == B1 solving degree (+-0) and slope in l equal, at all cells; 'advance candidate' only if B2 is strictly lower than BOTH B1 and C with slope in l (fit D=a*l+b) lower by >=0.25 with 95% bootstrap CI over targets excluding equality, and null N shows no such gap. VALIDITY CHECK first: for n<=17, l<=4 brute-force enumerate all 2^{3l} triples with the group law and confirm every arm has identical F_2-solution projection onto bits (arms A,B1,B2,C agree on SAT/UNSAT and on number of solutions). GRID: n in {11,13,17,19,23} (primes only), l in {ceil(n/3)-3 .. ceil(n/3)} intersect l<=7, plus fixed-n scan l=3..7 at n=17; 10 targets/cell split 50% SAT-planted (pick P1..P3 in V, set R=sum) / 50% random; cap each msolve call at 60 s CPU via timeout and record 'timeout' as censored (not as a degree); skip B2/C when A already times out. METRIC (counted, not wall time): (i) max F4 selected-pair degree from msolve -v 2 table, (ii) matrix rows/cols at that degree, (iii) number of degree-fall rounds (zero reductions>0); wall time recorded only as secondary. Report degree-vs-l slope per arm per n. SCALING STATEMENT required in output: only the slope-in-l and its n-dependence is extrapolated, with explicit note that toy data cannot certify B*D^2<N at n=131; classify as relabelling unless the decision rule triggers. Budget: ~25 cells x 10 targets x 5 arms=1250 runs, run SAT/UNSAT cells A,B1 first (cheap), B2,C only up to the cap; stay under 20 CPU-min by parallel -t 1 jobs and by dropping n=23 if A median > 5 s.
